WITH retired_legacy_tls AS (
  UPDATE vendor_findings
     SET status = 'closed'::finding_status,
         closed_at = now(),
         resolution = 'superseded_tls_severity_reference',
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE vendor_id = $1::uuid
     AND source = 'tls_expiry'
     AND left(
       source_ref,
       length('tls:' || ($7::jsonb ->> 'host') || ':' || ($7::jsonb ->> 'port') || ':')
     ) = 'tls:' || ($7::jsonb ->> 'host') || ':' || ($7::jsonb ->> 'port') || ':'
     AND source_ref <> $3
     AND status <> 'closed'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO vendor_findings
  (vendor_id, source, source_ref, title, description, severity, status, evidence, detected_at, due_date)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::finding_severity, 'open'::finding_status, $7::jsonb, now(),
  now() + CASE $6::finding_severity
    WHEN 'critical'::finding_severity THEN INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN 'high'::finding_severity THEN INTERVAL '14 days'
    WHEN 'medium'::finding_severity THEN INTERVAL '30 days'
    ELSE INTERVAL '60 days' END)
ON CONFLICT (vendor_id, source, source_ref) DO UPDATE
SET severity = EXCLUDED.severity,
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    evidence = EXCLUDED.evidence,
    status = CASE WHEN vendor_findings.status IN ('closed','accepted') THEN 'open'::finding_status ELSE vendor_findings.status END,
    closed_at = CASE WHEN vendor_findings.status IN ('closed','accepted') THEN NULL ELSE vendor_findings.closed_at END,
    resolution = CASE WHEN vendor_findings.status IN ('closed','accepted') THEN NULL ELSE vendor_findings.resolution END,
    due_date = CASE
      WHEN vendor_findings.status = 'closed' THEN EXCLUDED.due_date
      ELSE COALESCE(LEAST(vendor_findings.due_date, EXCLUDED.due_date), vendor_findings.due_date, EXCLUDED.due_date)
    END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE vendor_findings.status = 'closed'
   OR CASE EXCLUDED.severity
        WHEN 'critical'::finding_severity THEN 5
        WHEN 'high'::finding_severity THEN 4
        WHEN 'medium'::finding_severity THEN 3
        WHEN 'low'::finding_severity THEN 2
        ELSE 1
      END
      > CASE vendor_findings.severity
        WHEN 'critical'::finding_severity THEN 5
        WHEN 'high'::finding_severity THEN 4
        WHEN 'medium'::finding_severity THEN 3
        WHEN 'low'::finding_severity THEN 2
        ELSE 1
      END
RETURNING id, vendor_id, source, source_ref, title, description, severity;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ finding_id: $json.id, vendor_id: $json.vendor_id, severity: $json.severity, source: $json.source, source_ref: $json.source_ref, title: $json.title, description: $json.description }) }}

INSERT INTO monitoring_jobs (vendor_id, job_type, last_run, next_run, status, result_meta)
VALUES (NULL, $1, $5::timestamptz, now() + make_interval(mins => $2::int), $3, $4::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (job_type) WHERE vendor_id IS NULL
DO UPDATE SET last_run = EXCLUDED.last_run, next_run = EXCLUDED.next_run,
              status = EXCLUDED.status, result_meta = EXCLUDED.result_meta;
